tasks.title: Household internet access in four countries
tasks.prompt: The table below shows the percentage of households with internet access in four countries between 2005 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

dataTable.title: Percentage of households with internet access, 2005-2020

tasks.title: Water consumption by sector
tasks.prompt: The table below shows water consumption in millions of cubic metres by three sectors in one region of Australia in 1990, 2005 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

dataTable.title: Water consumption by sector (millions of cubic metres)

tasks.title: Letter about a lost item on a train
tasks.prompt: You recently travelled by train and left a bag on board when you got off at your station. Write a letter to the train company. In your letter: • describe the bag and its contents • explain when and where you left it • say what you would like the company to do

tasks.title: Remote working (opinion)
tasks.prompt: In many countries, an increasing number of employees are working from home rather than travelling to a workplace. Some people believe this trend benefits both workers and society as a whole. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

tasks.title: University purpose (discussion)
tasks.prompt: Some people think the main purpose of a university education is to prepare students for employment, while others believe universities should focus on developing knowledge and ideas for their own sake. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

tasks.title: Urban traffic congestion (problem-solution)
tasks.prompt: Traffic congestion in many cities around the world is becoming increasingly severe. What problems does this cause for individuals and society? What measures could governments take to address this situation?

tasks.title: Declining interest in cooking (two-part question)
tasks.prompt: In some countries, people are spending less time preparing meals at home and are relying more on ready-made food. Why is this happening? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?

tasks.title: Household recycling rates in three cities
tasks.prompt:
The line graph below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in three cities between 2005 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: How adults spent their leisure time
tasks.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the average number of hours per week that adults in one country spent on four leisure activities in 2005 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

chart.title: Average weekly leisure hours by activity

tasks.title: Where a university's income came from
tasks.prompt:
The pie chart below shows the sources of income for a university in a single academic year.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: What four countries generated their electricity from
tasks.prompt:
The chart below shows the proportion of electricity generated from four sources in four countries in 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Visitors to a coastal town across the year
tasks.prompt:
The line graph below shows the number of visitors to a coastal town in each month of one year, divided between day visitors and overnight visitors.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Age of first-time home buyers
tasks.prompt:
The bar chart below shows the average age of first-time home buyers in five regions in 2000 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Working from home (advantages and disadvantages)
tasks.prompt:
In many countries a large proportion of office work is now done from home rather than in a workplace.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

tasks.title: Museums: entertainment or education
tasks.prompt:
Some people believe that the main purpose of museums is to entertain visitors. Others argue that museums exist above all to educate.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

tasks.title: Ageing populations (problem and solution)
tasks.prompt:
In many countries people are living considerably longer, and the proportion of the population over sixty-five is rising.

What problems does this cause, and what measures could governments take to address them?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

tasks.title: Free public transport (opinion)
tasks.prompt:
Some people think that public transport should be free for everyone, paid for through taxation.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

tasks.title: Letter about a delayed order
tasks.prompt:
You ordered a piece of equipment from an online shop six weeks ago and it has still not arrived. You have contacted the shop twice and received no reply.

Write a letter to the shop's customer service manager. In your letter:

- explain what you ordered and when
- describe the attempts you have made to contact the company
- say what you would like them to do

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter 'Dear Sir or Madam,'.

tasks.title: Letter recommending a colleague
tasks.prompt:
A colleague you have worked with for several years is applying for a job at another organisation, and has asked you to write a reference.

Write a letter to the hiring manager. In your letter:

- explain how you know the person and for how long
- describe their strengths, with an example
- say why you think they suit the role

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter 'Dear Sir or Madam,'.

tasks.title: Letter asking a neighbour for help
tasks.prompt:
You are going to be away from home for a month and would like a neighbour to look after your flat while you are gone.

Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter:

- explain why you will be away
- describe what you would like them to do
- offer to do something for them in return

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter in an appropriate way.
